available_data: Twelve features already available before monitoring decision; no new measurements available.
model: Frozen logistic base; error geometry from depth-two XGBoost fit to squared residuals.
criterion: Maximize Brier contrast and affected share; report largest contrast with >=10% share.
current_constructor: Four observed medoids, nearest-leaf-output-distance partition; weak region must be ONE cell.

support.discovery_source: aml_error_clustering_current_20260921; same 40000 rows reused adaptively; fixed 3000-row medoid pool
support.geometry: Euclidean distance across actual per-tree leaf outputs, float64, no coordinate standardization
outer_array: current rare-event population; same fixed 40000-row discovery sample
objectives: largest eligible region Brier contrast versus pooled rest
support.primary_policy: maximum discovery contrast on Pareto frontier with share >= 0.10; tie larger share then earlier ID
support.parent_selection: fractional ownership of each objective within tolerances [0.005, 0.02], 5% uniform frontier exploration
support.mutation: 10% fresh uniform medoid set; otherwise replace one (75%) or two medoids; 50% local among 200 leaf-output neighbors
controls: Chapter 2 subset PAM, rescored under the loop contrast rule
reflection_options: one derived feature: difference, absolute difference or product
allow unions of up to two cells
support.medoid_pool: fixed Chapter 2 PAM subset, 3000 observed rows; scores on all 40000
support.inference: Bonferroni simultaneous normal intervals for 13 selected gaps and six paired differences (19 claims); iid observations conditional on fixed fits
restrictions: no previous confirmation data supplied to search or LLM
no simulated group labels supplied to search or LLM
no retries chosen for favorable LLM content

excluded: No confirmation observations, simulation rules, hidden groups or author-preferred transformation supplied.
